:::{#exr-best-step-length}

#### The best step length for eigenvalues 1 and 9

Gradient descent with a constant step length converges slowly if the step is too small
and diverges if it is too large.
@thm-best-constant-step gives the step length that shrinks the error bound fastest,
from the smallest and largest [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue) of $\matr{S}$.

Let $\matr{S} = \sbmat{ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 9 }$,
a diagonal matrix, so its eigenvalues are its diagonal entries, 1 and 9.
Using @thm-best-constant-step, find $\steplen^*$.

:::
